blind.description: A stylized medieval weapon rack constructed from warm polished wood planks flanked by two decorative square posts with beveled caps. It holds five pole weapons neatly arranged upright in lower slots: two halberds/poleaxes, a curved glaive blade, a spear point, and a hooked polearm. The metal blades have clean silver textures and the shafts are wooden with metal ferrule bands. The rear consists of a solid wooden panel wall.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular profile bordered by square end post caps, revealing the thin cross-section of the wooden backboard and the tops of five silvery weapon blades aligned along the rack.
blind.height_vs_figure: The wooden frame stands slightly below shoulder height of the figure (around 4.8 ft tall), with the tallest blade tips reaching about 5.2 ft; the rack is approximately 3.5 ft wide.
